attendance.title: Attendance
rules: Minimum attendance is 75% in each course (placeholder value; a common norm in Indian universities).
Students below 75% in a course are not eligible to write that course's semester-end exam.
Attendance between 65% and 74% may be condoned once per semester with a medical certificate, subject to approval by the Head of Department.
Attendance is updated in the portal every Friday.

internal_assessments.title: Internal assessments
rules: There are two internal assessments (IA-1 and IA-2) per course, each out of 20 marks.
The better of the two plus assignments makes up the internal component shown in each course's assessment pattern.
A missed IA can be retaken only with a valid medical or official-duty letter, within 7 days.

semester_end_exams.title: Semester-end exams
rules: Hall tickets are issued only to students who meet attendance and have no pending fees.
Students must report 20 minutes before the exam. Entry closes 15 minutes after the start.
Mobile phones and smart watches are not allowed in the exam hall.

fees.title: Fee deadlines
rules: Semester tuition fee: Rs. 1,25,000 (fictional amount), due by the 15th day of the semester.
A late fee of Rs. 500 per week applies after the due date.
Fees pending beyond 30 days block the hall ticket for semester-end exams.
Payment receipts can be downloaded from the student portal.

leave.title: Leave applications
rules: CampusMate can file a leave request of up to 3 days on its own.
Requests longer than 3 days need approval from the class mentor and must be submitted through the department office.
A student may take at most 6 days of leave per semester through CampusMate.
Leave does not count as attendance. Approved leave days are still absences in the attendance register.

re_evaluation.title: Re-evaluation
rules: Apply for re-evaluation within 7 days of results being published.
Fee: Rs. 750 per course (fictional amount).
If marks change by more than 10%, the re-evaluation fee is refunded.

library.title: Library
rules: Students can borrow up to 4 books for 14 days.
A fine of Rs. 5 per day per book applies after the due date.
Books can be renewed once online if nobody else has reserved them.

hackathons.title: Hackathon participation
rules: Students may take part in up to 2 external hackathons per semester with on-duty (OD) attendance.
Apply for OD at least 3 working days before the event with the registration proof.
Teams must have a faculty mentor for any hackathon that uses the college name.
